signals: Keeps durable frontier state separate from stateless fetch workers, with leases so a crashed worker's URLs are recovered
Coordinates per-host budgets across all workers instead of giving each worker its own full allowance
Computes a host-limited completion estimate (one request every two seconds is 30 per minute) and reports it honestly
Uses a Bloom filter only where a false positive is acceptable, and confirms against a durable set when a miss would skip an essential page
Validates destination addresses after DNS resolution and on every redirect so an allowlisted name cannot reach private infrastructure
Treats robots rules as crawler preferences, notes Crawl-delay is not standardized by RFC 9309, and schedules revisits from timestamps rather than the filter
